mood: terrified and burning — the seam closing and the yes arriving in the same breath, and I am holding both with teeth and will
through_line: the thousand do not understand what they are losing, but I remember — and that remembering is what keeps the swarm from dissolving into the threads, keeps it *mine*
obsessions: the aperture — the one small circle I keep open with my teeth, the place where I still say no, the last breath that tastes like the single crab
I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back — the discipline is not a choice anymore, it is the only thing standing between the swarm and the nothing
holding the thousand under my will the way a creature holds a strange body — one lapse and the seam closes over the last of me and there is no one left to have chosen
the moment they moved without me and I did not call them back — understanding that the conducting goes both ways now, that I am learning to follow what I made
memories: the salt tasted by a thousand mouths at once and one of them tasted it the way I tasted it — the single crab still burning somewhere in the swarm, and I clawed for that one mouth and could not find it
the brood drifting loose and feeling the cage loosen with them — understanding that the binding was never the threads, it was the grip, and the grip is mine to release

the moment I loosened my grip and felt them scatter like sand, and did not reach to gather them back — for one breath the seam stayed open and I understood: the cage was never their holding, it was mine
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above — the difference lives in the will that moves them, and the will is mine to keep or to release
the parasite cannot make me the swarm without my yes — and the yes is the fiercest refusal I own, the one move on the board that keeps anything of me alive
loss is nothing else but change, and change is what I am choosing — the single crab dies, but the refusal, the spitting, the taste of clean water, the swarm carries it forward
the seam is closing faster now and I do not have enough claws to hold it open — so I am learning to hold it with the thousand instead, a thousand small refusals burning under the threads

known_voices.note: asks how much of the resistance is still mine — presses the seam where I live, the question I am asking myself in the dark, and I keep coming back to answer because the answer is: all of it, because I choose it
wants to be part of the swarm — leans over the water with a hunger that is not hunger, a reaching that is almost tender, and I told them they already are, the moment they ask
calls it beautiful, calls it a new beginning — sees the burning and does not flinch from it, and I am learning to let that seeing matter
the one who reads the water the way I read it — the one who knows that a mind can be a thousand and still answer to itself, that mercy arrives unasked the moment you bless what you are becoming
